title: Test Condition
description: One condition per file at plans/<plan_id>/conditions/<id>.json. Sharding by ID makes every mutation an atomic replacement of a small file, never a patch to a large file.

id.description: Must match the filename excluding .json — checked by the harness

plan_id.description: Must match the parent directory's plan.json — the harness checks referential integrity

requirement_id.description: Cites either a REQ- requirement id or an INV-<AREA>-<N> design invariant id (docs/reference/invariant-contract.md) — this harness uses both families for citable requirements, and a test condition traces to whichever one the spec actually produced.

behavior.description: One testable sentence: given/when/then or an invariant

property_kind.description: Required when technique = property; forbidden otherwise

rationale.description: Why this technique fits this behavior_shape
